description: Connect your existing Vruum workspace to review revenue priorities and manage people, accounts, objectives, outreach, deals, content, relationships, research, and revenue reporting. Use guided workflows to inspect pipeline risks, review and edit drafts, and record requested updates. Connected providers support external research, sending, publication, and advertising when you authorize those actions. Access follows your Vruum permissions, and execution follows your workspace approval and spending policies.
